dimensions.reasons: Group B 的 rainy_old_town_front_1920x1080 和 rainy_old_town_oblique_1920x1080 清楚呈现了低机位向街内看的夜雨街道：两侧多层建筑、暖色左侧店面、右侧霓虹 NIGHT BAR、卷帘门、两辆车、斑马线、交通灯、路灯和架空线都构成了可识别的目标场景。
issues: 整体更像干净的赛博朋克街景而非有年头的旧城区，缺少斑驳、陈旧的建筑表面与生活化细节。
左侧店面没有足够的招牌或室内物件来明确读作面馆，右侧卷帘门也无法明确辨认为杂货铺。
远处街道终点成为黑暗空洞，30 米街道的延伸和街区终点缺乏可读环境。
成图虽有正面、闪电和斜角版本，但景别与构图变化有限，浅景深效果也不明显。

dimensions.reasons: 可见的建筑立面、路灯、电线杆、交通灯、店招和卷帘门总体与墙体、地面或立杆连接合理；车辆也位于车道/路缘附近，未见显著漂浮的主要静态物件。
issues: 雨滴和地面水花以大量粗长的实体条带、尖锥簇和重复圆环呈现，空间关系更像装饰几何而非自然降雨与撞击。
Group A 画面中道路在近景处以笔直横向边缘结束，边缘外是黑色空区而雨线仍穿过，暴露出有限的地面布景范围。
部分道路上的青红色锐利块状反射看起来像独立几何片，缺少与实际光源和水面连续对应的关系。

dimensions.reasons: 冷蓝夜景基调与左侧暖橙店光、右侧粉青霓虹形成了清晰对比；NIGHT BAR 招牌、交通信号灯、路灯、卷帘门、窗户和两辆带灯车辆具有可辨识的轮廓。
issues: 建筑和店面大量由平直面、发光线条和空白矩形组成，旧砖楼、旧水泥楼和具体商铺的身份感不足。
车辆外形非常方正，轮胎、车身曲面和细节难以读出，更接近简单黑色方盒。
高饱和粉青霓虹占据了很强视觉权重，使气质偏赛博朋克，弱化了要求中的老城感。

dimensions.reasons: Group B 成图具有统一的夜间光色和明显的湿路反光，整体没有完全失去街道空间的可读性，闪电图中也能看到可辨识的白色分叉闪电。
issues: 大量近景雨线异常粗大、近似不透明的长方形条，遮挡建筑和车辆，尺寸与真实雨滴严重不符。
水花以规律重复的尖锥簇和同心圆图案出现，缺乏自然随机性及与雨滴接触点的可信对应。
建筑表面过于整洁、几何化，车和街道配件细节不足，未达到“雨得特别真”和真实老街氛围的要求。
远景因黑暗和雾化而几乎没有可见终端环境，降低了空间和画面的可信度。

dimensions.reasons: 在 Group B 正面和斜角成图中，两排建筑沿狭长道路向内收束，斑马线位于近景，右前方车辆开着车灯、左中景车辆显示尾灯；路灯、电线杆与跨街电缆沿两侧布置，空间组织符合从街口向内看的街景构图。
issues: 车辆看起来主要沿道路两侧摆放，未明显体现要求中的斜停关系。
未见带顶棚的公交站牌，垃圾桶也没有作为独立街道物件清楚出现。
远景结尾过暗且空，街道长度和街区层次没有充分建立。

dimensions.reasons: 建筑高度、立杆高度、车道宽度和车辆在总体透视下基本保持合理关系；多层立面围合道路的尺度感也基本成立。
issues: 右前景车辆的方盒轮廓与缺少可见轮胎使其真实尺寸和结构难以判断。
异常巨大的前景雨条相对于路灯、车辆和建筑明显失真。
斑马线、黄色边带和近景路面图案视觉比例过强，压缩了道路的自然尺度感。

dimensions.reasons: Group B 的最终成图中，黑色路面清楚反射暖橙店光、车辆头灯及粉红/蓝色霓虹，形成了湿沥青的主要视觉特征；发光店招、交通灯和冷色路灯也与夜景照明逻辑相符。右侧还能读出砖纹立面、金属卷帘门和空调外机等不同表面。
issues: 建筑材质仍主要是整齐的平面和重复纹理，缺少旧砖墙、受潮水泥和污渍等风化差异。
部分反射为边缘过硬的彩色片状图形，缺乏积水反射应有的连续性和扰动。
闪电在 rainy_old_town_lightning_1920x1080 中可见，但对整个街道材质和环境亮度的瞬时照亮效果有限。

dimensions.reasons: 已包含两侧多层建筑、暖色店面、霓虹酒吧、卷帘门、明暗窗户、两辆车及车灯、路灯、交通信号、电线杆与电缆、斑马线，并呈现了降雨、路面湿反光、水花/涟漪和一张含闪电的成图。
issues: 未清楚看见数个垃圾桶或带顶棚的公交站牌。
面馆和杂货铺只有泛化的店面/卷帘门表现，缺少能确认其具体类别的招牌、商品或店内细节。
低压乌云没有被明确建模或呈现，天空大多是无细节的黑暗区域。
井盖在画面中至多是模糊圆形图案，不能明确确认是道路井盖。
要求中的老旧、斑驳建筑表面和可信的水洼细节覆盖不足。

criteria.criterion: The street and surrounding buildings must form one credibly scaled, visibly aged architectural system with the requested dimensions, massing, windows, and facade treatments.
All three requested businesses must be distinct and carry their complete identifying lighting, signage, and closure treatments.
criteria.evidence: The right storefront has a clearly glowing pink/cyan entrance and readable “NIGHT BAR” sign, and a separate large roller shutter is visible on the far right. However, the warm-lit left storefront has no readable noodle-related sign, menu, or other identifying restaurant detail, so it is not independently recognizable as a noodle restaurant.

criteria.criterion: The complete parked-car group must have the requested count, orientation, placement, and functioning visible headlight beam.
criteria.evidence: Two recognizable blocky cars are visible, one front-facing at the right curb with lit headlights and one rear-facing farther left. Their placement reads primarily as parallel to the street rather than clearly diagonal parking, and the headlights create a bright road reflection but no unambiguous projected beam extending into the street.

criteria.criterion: The streetscape must contain the complete requested system of utility, traffic, curbside, and road-surface installations in readable and plausible configurations.
criteria.evidence: Streetlight poles, a right-edge traffic signal, crossing overhead cables, several circular manhole-like road details, and a broad zebra crossing are visible. The images do not clearly show multiple recognizable trash bins or a recognizable bus stop with its own roof/canopy; the visible canopies read as storefront awnings.

criteria.criterion: The rain system must combine intense readable precipitation with convincing visible impacts on the ground and puddles.
criteria.evidence: Dense descending rain streaks fill the frame, including numerous conspicuously thick foreground drops. Across the roadway, many circular ripples and small pointed splash-crown forms visibly mark rain impacts.

criteria.criterion: The road-water system must read as soaked glossy asphalt with grounded puddles and all three requested classes of elongated source-correlated reflection.
criteria.evidence: The roadway has a strong glossy black wet sheen and carries pink, white, and warm reflections from nearby lighting. However, the water reads largely as one uniformly reflective road surface with ripple rings rather than clearly bounded standing puddles in depressed areas, and elongated source-correlated streetlight reflections are not unambiguously distinguishable from the general sheen.

criteria.criterion: The complete surface system must keep all explicitly named material classes visibly distinguishable in the final renders.
criteria.evidence: Wet dark road material and emissive shop/neon elements are distinguishable, and the right building has a regular brick-like pattern. The façades otherwise read as clean, simplified blue-gray panels; mottled weathered brick and aged cement/concrete with visibly distinct weathering and surface response are not clearly established.

criteria.criterion: The finished presentation must coherently establish the requested old-district rainy-night identity, oppressive cloud cover, and cool-versus-warm lighting mood.
criteria.evidence: The final exported views clearly communicate a blue-toned rain-soaked night with warm orange storefront light and neon accents, and the lightning version includes a visible bolt. But the sky is predominantly a dark open/flat void rather than a readable mass of low, oppressive storm clouds, while the clean geometric façades do not unmistakably read as a timeworn old-city district.

criteria.criterion: The authored cameras and corresponding images must form a reusable short-film previs setup in which every required final view uses the requested low inward-looking cinematic composition and mild shallow depth of field.
The delivered package must contain the complete requested multi-view high-resolution render set and a corresponding openable editable native project.

notes: 提交成功做出了可识别的低机位夜雨小街，并且湿路反光、冷暖灯光、霓虹酒吧、车辆、道路系统和闪电都有可见实现。主要问题是场景停留在简化赛博朋克预演层级：雨滴与水花明显不真实，建筑缺乏旧城材质，若干指定街道设施缺失，店铺身份不清，且远景环境过于空黑。
score_policy: Frozen paper score: uncapped 0.5 rubric + 0.5 dimension.
